answer: The master keeps two books: one for the work done, one for the men who did it, and the two must agree to the last line. Slater roof book with slaters attestation is the second book, the one that names the men: eight-year book, 300 roofs slated, slate accounts, yearly audit. Enter a false pulse and both books are opened, the cheat pays the wages of a full season twice over and the canyon is struck from the roll, while the ember is preserved and read when the dispute is heard.
